text_block_list.text: During certain journey――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――Hey old-timer, you alright?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Here, eat this. Like they say, "travel 
needs companion, life needs kindness", 
right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Never heard it? Haha! No big deal then!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, interesting spot. Why wedges 
driven around all these trees?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…I see, local Feb 14th ritual blessing 
couples on travels.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Pretty romantic. Y'know, Japan has 
Valentine's custom too――

text_block_list.name: Stego Student Fan A
text_block_list.text: Stego-senpai! Accept my feelings, please…!

text_block_list.name: Stego Student Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Chocolates packed with promise to support 
you forever! Please……!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
All gifts for Big Sis go in box. Leave 
letters with me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Right, 14th today…… No wonder feeling 
nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Where did I put stuff from back then?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If recall right, old man gave me whole 
tool set――

Academy Valentine's Day filled with 
warmth, shy looks, bittersweet moments.
Yet on this very day I ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Aaand there we go. Soil should be just 
about ready now.
choice_data_list: Why are you out here levelling the soil…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, soil froze over during winter. Gotta 
prep it like this first.
choice_data_list: なぜ、土ならしを……

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's only meaningful because it's 
done today. Ceremonies got conditions you 
gotta meet first!
choice_data_list: そういうことじゃなくて、なんで今日……？

text_block_list.text:
I stopped her to ask what she was doing; 
turns out there was a ritual she wanted to 
try after hearing about it on one of her 
journeys.
choice_data_list: いや、だからどういうこと！？

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Special ritual done on February 14th. 
Seems couples use it to wish for blessings 
on journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
We're comrades on our ongoing journey, 
right? Not bad idea to give it a shot 
then.
choice_data_list: …Blessings for a journey …Sounds good

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Right? Knew you'd say that!
choice_data_list: ……旅路の祝福か……いいかも

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Alright, soil is flat now. Let's start.
choice_data_list: What are the steps for this ritual?
What are the steps for this ritual?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, we're just planting tree seed 
—— just few special steps to follow.
choice_data_list: 儀式って、何をすればいいんだ？
儀式って、何をすればいいの？

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
First, two participants drive stakes 
around area where they plant seeds.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Then, take turns driving stakes in. 
Whoever's turn it is makes wish for 
journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, no need to overthink it. Let's give 
it a go.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……Hmm, guess I'll start by wishing for safe travels ahead.

I copied Stay Gold's actions, hammered 
stake, voiced wish for our journey.
choice_data_list: For you to enter many thrilling races
For you to enter many thrilling races

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That, and —— journeys, y'know, gotta be 
fun.
choice_data_list: 君が心躍るレースに多く出会えますように
貴方が心躍るレースに多く出会えますように

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
——Hey, you're not making any wishes for 
yourself, are you?
choice_data_list: 君がこの旅路を自由に楽しめますように
貴方がこの旅路を自由に楽しめますように

text_block_list.text:
Her words made me realize it. Wishing her 
journey goes well… comes straight from 
bottom of my heart.
choice_data_list: I'm properly voicing my own wishes

text_block_list.text:
Lining up to strike stake again, I 
announce my wish: "To walk beside you on 
your Golden Journey…"
choice_data_list: ちゃんと自分の望みを言ってるよ

text_block_list.text:
Lining up to strike stake again, I 
announce my wish: "To walk beside you on 
your Golden Journey…"
choice_data_list: ずっと隣で、見続けていられますように

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
choice_data_list: ずっと隣で、見続けていられますように

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
For this journey —— to never end, no 
matter where it leads.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now that stakes form circle in ground, we 
pick seed to plant.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Before long, roots run deep, leaves 
flourish, wishes on stakes come true. Tree 
will watch over our journey.
choice_data_list: It's amazing… What seed are we picking?
It's wonderful… What are we growing?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Sorbus aucuparia, rowan tree. Says it 
watches over travelers so they don't get 
lost.
choice_data_list: 素敵だな……何を植えるんだ？
素敵だね……何を植えるの？

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Can make jam or jelly with berries too, so 
Chairwoman said okay to plant at edge of 
field.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: We plant seeds and cover with soil.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Heheh, working together like this is best.
choice_data_list: You're right… Or perhaps

text_block_list.text:
Ritual where we wish together for endless 
journey… something about this feels……
choice_data_list: 確かに……というか

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright, covered top with fallen leaves, 
so frost won't be issue.
choice_data_list: （願いというより、祈りのようだ）

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm? You alright, Trainer?
choice_data_list: No, it's nothing at all

text_block_list.text:
We finished ritual. Can check on seeds 
another time.
choice_data_list: ううん、なんでもない

text_block_list.text:
"May our journey find happiness from here 
on." If I silently pray right now ——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyone got chocolate～～! Trick or 
Choco～～!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's with you, Golshi? Valentine's 
and Halloween double combo?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Better hand over chocolate～～ Else we're 
going tuna fishing on my Golden Valentine 
Vessel～!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: C'mon, c'mon, Stego~? Trick orーー
choice_data_list: H-H-Have this!

text_block_list.text:
I opened chocolate bag I had on me and 
gave one to Gold Ship.
choice_data_list: こ、これをっ！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhhh! Bite-sized chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, you had chocolates this whole 
time?
choice_data_list: Well… I thought of sharing them with you
Well… I thought of sharing them with you

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, so that's how it is.
choice_data_list: 実は……君と一緒に食べようと思っていて
実は……貴方と一緒に食べようと思っていて

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Confiscating this then. Too bad for you, 
Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, leaving this tree to you, 
Trainer.

Hearing that, I realized… Stay Gold will 
probably be setting off on journeys often 
from now on.

Totally carefree —— but that's just how 
she is.
choice_data_list:
Leave it to me, I'll become it's 
protector!

Leave it to me, I'll become it's 
protector!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Aah, thanks. Know you'll raise it into 
great tree.
choice_data_list: まかせて、俺が樹の守り人になるよ！
まかせて、私が樹の守り人になるよ！

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Hey, tree guardian. Looking forward to 
seeing it grow big and strong.
choice_data_list:
$(scale 95)So you can make jam or jelly 
from this?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, course. When time comes, let's enjoy 
it together.
choice_data_list: 実はジャムやゼリーにできるんだっけ？

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
——Got one more thing to look forward to on 
my journey.
(Grumble...)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Fuhaha! What's that? Berries haven't even sprouted yet!
choice_data_list: S-S-Sorry……

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
True, hard work works up an appetite——— 
ah.
choice_data_list: ご、ごめん……

text_block_list.text:
Felt hard touch against lips, then smelled 
sweet aroma next second.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's. ——Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Though single chocolate ain't gonna fill 
you up.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Let's go find something tasty, Trainer!
